messages:
anna: Heads-up: i'm prototyping a small ops runbook + console toggle for per-key priority buckets (P0/P1/P2). goal: make routing, sampling, and quota visibility explicit without changing pricing. quick brainstorm here before i write the RFC.

mike: sounds useful. main constraints: 1) minimal infra churn, 2) clear precedence rules, 3) observable spill behavior.

sam: implementation note: we already have route_preference on keys. i'd reuse it and add a priority enum separate from public UI wording. infra mapping: P0->fast_pool, P1->default_pool, P2->cheap_pool.

rashid: ops perspective: we need a failover policy. if fast_pool is saturated, default to spill->default_pool for P0 (with rate-limit) and emit a span tag "spilled_from". don't silently downgrade without audit log.

anna: good. console UX thoughts: simple dropdown on key page with tooltip: "P0: low latency (default fast routing). P1: balanced. P2: cost-optimized." option to lock at org level and bulk-change keys. show an estimated cost delta and expected p95 latency band. also add a small badge next to the key in list view indicating bucket.

mike: quotas: show project-level consumption split by priority buckets (tokens_by_priority). per-key quotas are noisy; hide by default but provide an admin query. add alert: if any key in P2 uses >25% of project quota in 5m, fire an investigatory alert.

sam: telemetry: add span tag "priority_bucket" and analytic dimension "target_pool". sampling defaults: P0=100% traces, P1=10%-adaptive, P2=1% traces + 100% aggregated counters. will implement adaptive sampling for P1 based on error spikes.

rashid: deployment/runbook: feature-flag behind org opt-in. rollout steps: 1) internal enable + dogfood for 3 days, 2) invite beta customers, 3) monitor metrics (spill_rate, latency_by_priority, cost_by_priority), 4) flip default after 2 weeks if gates pass. metric gates: spill_rate <2% for P0, org p95 delta <5%, cost delta <10% aggregated.

anna: owners? sam -> telemetry & dashboards; mike -> routing+spill logic; rashid -> ops/runbook and alerts; anna -> RFC + console mocks. i'll attach a mockup link in the RFC.

deploy-bot: deployment note: canary rollout plan template created: https://internal.deploys/templates/priority-canary.

mike: one more item: reserved/dedicated pools should always take precedence when customer has reservation and key is P0, unless org override explicitly forces spill. add config flag: honor_reservations: true by default.

sam: will also emit metrics labelled reservation_used to compute upsell signals.

anna: thanks. i'll draft the RFC and include the mock screenshots + sampling numbers. sync Friday 11am to review the doc and gate thresholds. :thumbsup:
